description: MEOW: keep custom skills and hooks registered with Claude Code; drive /meow:autopilot runs.

hooks.command: input=$(cat); case "$input" in *.meow*|*SKILL.md*|*.toml*) command -v meow >/dev/null 2>&1 && meow sync --auto PostToolUse --work-dir "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" ;; esac; exit 0
[ -d "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.meow/autopilot" ] && command -v meow >/dev/null 2>&1 && meow autopilot hook Stop --work-dir "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || true
[ -d "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.meow/autopilot" ] && command -v meow >/dev/null 2>&1 && meow autopilot hook StopFailure --work-dir "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || true
[ -d "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.meow/autopilot" ] && command -v meow >/dev/null 2>&1 && meow autopilot hook Notification --work-dir "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || true
